correctness.rationale: Read the entire frozen RESULT.md and Foata-normal-form verification code and verified the actual Git tree and each original blob. Support is invariant under defining relations; every nonedge retracts onto the free product of two two-element idempotent monoids, forcing idempotent supports to be cliques. The nonedge retractions and commuting-letter absorption show C(e_S)=intersection_{s in S} C(s). If T\S includes nonuniversal t, e_S b e_S for any nonneighbor b of t witnesses failure of C(e_S)⊆C(e_T); otherwise universal generators make inclusion automatic. The center is precisely the Boolean semilattice generated by universal vertices. Inclusion becomes reverse inclusion of cliques of H=Gamma minus its universal vertices, including empty/complete cases; the face poset reconstructs H and log_2 |Z| restores removed vertices. The word-truncation tests are corroboration, not proof for all graphs and monoid elements.

value.rationale: The invariant classifies all finite simple defining graphs (including empty and complete cases) through centralizer-order data of generally infinite monoids; the universal-vertex correction is provably indispensable, making it a natural sharp reconstruction result rather than a routine recounting of general centralizers.

final_claim: For every finite simple graph, the poset of distinct idempotent centralizers of its graph product of two-element semilattice monoids, together with the center size, determines the graph up to isomorphism; the poset is the opposite clique-face poset after removing universal vertices.
